art_direction.view: elevated oblique looking north from south

assets.subject: Harim castle and tell
assets.notes: 12th-century Muslim-held frontier citadel on elevated tell, few low curtain walls and rectangular towers, no later architecture; earlier town treatment may exist

assets.subject: Apamea / Qal'at al-Mudiq citadel
assets.notes: 12th-century fortification on ancient mound; rectangular towers; historically interpretive; no intact classical temples invented

assets.subject: Nabi Samwil hilltop shrine complex
assets.notes: restrained pre-13th-century hilltop religious fortified compound; avoid extant later minaret and modern forms

assets.subject: Mount Tabor church and fortified precinct
assets.notes: 12th-century hilltop basilica precinct; avoid 13th-century later fortifications and modern Transfiguration basilica

assets.subject: Kykkos monastery
assets.notes: Cyprus early monastery, modest Byzantine structures in wooded mountains; no later extensive roofs and 18th-century architecture

assets.subject: Bellapais Abbey early Lusignan phase
assets.notes: after c. 1198-1205 foundation; simple 13th-century church and early precinct; exclude 14th-century cloisters and refectory, not on 1180 map
